title: Sharing Patterns
subtitle: Pass resource vs createResourceHooks — no Context
description: Two supported ways to share a resource across components.
content: React Context is intentionally not used. Choose based on multi-instance needs.

sections.title: 1. Pass `resource`
sections.content: Best when multiple instances can mount (lists, split panes). Shell owns `useResource`; children take `resource` prop into `useField` / `useFieldArray`.

sections.title: 2. Module bound hooks
sections.content: `createResourceHooks` creates a module singleton. Children call `useField('name')` with no prop. One active identity at a time.

sections.title: 3. Collections
sections.content: For many rows: `useCollection` + `getResource(id)` per row. Remount boards with React `key={workspaceId}` when the list identity changes.

dos: Use bound hooks for a single editor route
Pass resource (or use collection) when many entities edit in parallel
donts: Don't mount two bound useResource calls with different ids in the same tree
Don't wrap the app in a custom Context just to avoid props — use the patterns above
